name: Melissa ❤️
source:
Have you heard of this NEW GAME they installed on the high-tech computer at the library? We've all played it! You should too! It's real cute!

Meet MELISSA, your date in a brand spankin' new game called "DATE TIME". She is a sweetheart!  A bright, young woman... who is looking for someone with a gentle touch! She loves a GOOD BOOK, and she has always wanted to date a TALENTED ARTIST! But she isn't into SPORTS so JOCKS... please do NOT APPLY! Play your cards right, and you'll get a SMOOCH from the cutest person ever!

[From [url=https://cattrigger.itch.io/melissa-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
